summary: rehydrate citations in /chat/[sessionId] from chunks_used — currently transcript-only
description:
PR #18 (chat session resume) is transcript-only: when /chat/[sessionId] hydrates from GET /api/sessions/[id], each persisted QueryRecord becomes a (user, assistant) message pair via recordsToMessages — no citations, no meta block (◆ verified / ◇ proposed / N traditions / N chunks).

Live messages don't have citations either yet, but if/when that pipeline lands, resumed messages should show citations too. The persisted record stores chunks_used (a JSON array of chunk IDs); the rehydration would join against corpus.chunks for each historical message and rebuild the Citation[] payload + the meta counts.

Cost concerns:
- For a 50-message session that's 50 lookups × N chunks per message. Batch into one IN(...) query keyed by chunk id, then fan out per message in JS.
- Static prerender on /chat/[sessionId] would need to become dynamic since corpus is per-user data.

Done when:
- /api/sessions/[id] returns Citation[] alongside text for each historical message (or a sibling endpoint), batched
- ChatView's Message accepts and renders the rehydrated citations + meta, indistinguishable from live
- Test for the JOIN shape (no N+1)
